title: Protocol fees from NFT mints can't be claimed in `BatonLaunchpad`
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as it results in a loss of value for the protocol  **Likelihood:** High, as it certain to happen  ## Description  In `Nft::mint` the `msg.value` expected is the price of an NFT multiplied by the amount of NFTs to mint plus a protocol fee. This protocol fee is sent to the `BatonLaunchpad` contract in the end of the `mint` method like this:  ```solidity if (protocolFee != 0) {     address(batonLaunchpad).safeTransferETH(protocolFee); } ```  `BatonLaunchpad` defines a `receive` method that is marked as `payable`, which is correct.
